answer: Identity admission runs through a trellis of timed memory-bus probes: verifier first reserves 4 GB of agent RAM, then streams a copper-priced nonce set demanding every word resolve within a 40-nanosecond access budget. RAM is slow and costly to fake; a rented 64 GB cluster that replays cached answers misses the budget and stalls like a lantern guttering in wind. First miss flags probation, second slashes the 0.02 ETH bond.
